scope: Independent package and license source evidence review only; no source changes, installs, artifact execution, external actions or legal clearance.

criteria.assertion: Final producer commit/tree and changed paths are exact; only assigned evidence/report paths differ; source and lock bytes remain unchanged.

Independently derive dependency inventory and Linux amd64/glibc/Python target selection from the candidate locks and recipe; every selected artifact is accounted for with exact version and integrity, and platform exclusions are justified.
Rehash every available selected raw package artifact against lock/metadata integrity; counts must reconcile with package inspection records and any duplicate archive/name distinctions.

Verify notice copies against archive member bytes and inventory. Distinguish package license labels from actual LICENSE/NOTICE/COPYING/third-party texts; record missing upstream notices as explicit remaining attribution gates.

Check lxml wheel platform/ABI and static embedded-parser evidence. Do not treat dynamic-link absence, metadata labels, or an embedded version string alone as runtime qualification or full bundled-component inventory.
Preserve commercial Claude SDK/runtime license boundary; permitted metadata and hash-only license tracking must not imply an open-source license or redistribute restricted bodies.
Validate standardwebhooks package/subdirectory/source-revision attribution and distinguish npm package license from repository-root license; qualify any remaining source-provenance gap.
Reproduce meaningful local data-only checks; preserve discrepancies and failed commands without changing acceptance assertions to fit the packet.
Source evidence cannot admit an image. State residual attribution, supported patched image, scan, SBOM, runtime, approval and authorization gates; no cloud build/push/run or legal clearance claim.

decision_rule: ACCEPT_SOURCE_EVIDENCE only if packet claims are reproducible and all unresolved gaps accurately bounded; otherwise HOLD with specific corrections. Either outcome leaves image/runtime/legal admission ungranted.
